mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Area High School and an air quality index of 53.

The City of Verona has announced that a section of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed for road improvements from October 6 through October 9, with detours directed through Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street. Additionally, early voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall starting October 20.
There is plenty to do in town, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia happening today, while tomorrow features the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park and live music at Paddy Mac's.

In a notable incident on September 24, an 11-year-old child on a bicycle collided with a vehicle at Westward Drive after failing to stop at a sign, though thankfully they did not require hospitalization.
Stop into Culver's today to enjoy the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day before they close their doors at 10 PM.
